'''Tekurr'k''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tekurr'k system/Legends|Tekurr'k system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]].

==Description==
It was an industrial world,<ref name="FT" /> lying on the crossroads of the [[Belsavis Run]] and the [[Anturi Reach]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Colonized by the [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] that settled the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region, the [[House Picutorion]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was built into an industrial powerhouse. By processing raw materials that the nearby planet of [[Atron]] lacked, Tekurr'k was able to make a profit by selling them off for less money. This allowed Tekurr'k to gain prominence, and their economy experienced a boom.<ref name="TEA" />
